rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for resin, including both natural plant resin and synthetic resin.

example.english: The resin that comes out of pine trees can be used to make varnish.
example.traditional: 松樹流出嘅樹脂可以用嚟整清漆。
example.jyutping: cung4 syu6 lau4 ceot1 ge3 syu6 zi1 ho2 ji5 jung6 lei4 zing2 cing1 cat1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean synthetic resin rather than resin in general.

example.english: This plastic box is made of synthetic resin.
example.traditional: 呢個膠盒係用合成樹脂整嘅。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gaau1 hap6 hai6 jung6 hap6 sing4 syu6 zi1 zing2 ge3
